title: Very flimsy and easily breakable
text: Very flimsy and easily breakable. This product breaks very easily and is made of very cheap material. It's not worth the time and money. Unfortunately, we had to return ours seeing as it was very bad quality. In the end, you get what you pay for, and I would recommend investing in a slightly more expensive product as it will most likely last longer.
